items.title: Dimension with an e-prefixed unit serializes to a number token
Numeric faster
items.body: The following commit: * Removes char logic from consume_numeric. * Rearranges exponent parsing to look at one char in the common case (presumably not a big deal). This makes the benchmark added in the first commit go from: test tests::numeric ... bench: 48,221,308 ns/iter (+/- 3,356,881) to: test tests::numeric ... bench: 43,656,802 ns/iter (+/- 1,323,570) on my machine. Which is pretty much a micro-optimization, but perhaps it's worth given how common these values are. --- This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/servo/rust-cssparser/132)
